title: Shipping overview
text: Shipping reads one authorized overview across projects, unions each project’s bounded live/recent run window before presentation, and shows each shared release once. Another project’s busy window cannot truncate a selected project’s releases. Project chips filter by member project, or the owning project of an itemless run. Shipping immediately announces that deployment runs and current QA obligations are loading. It reads and paints the authorized overview before starting auxiliary evidence requests, so source-only Not started rows do not wait for attempt history or flow names. Cards show available release facts while auxiliary QA evidence and flow names load; loading and failed evidence reads stay explicit. Member QA retains the release gate’s acceptance authority, and landing attribution keeps the first successful delivery in each environment. Deployed timing remains subject to production proof. The candidate batches current QA facts within one presentation and keeps canonical acceptance validation. Unrun cases stay unrun; later calls see changed withdrawals and verdicts. Overview source pins omit the bulky frozen driver preparation receipt; exact detail reads retain that receipt for recovery. The CLI overview read exposes this scope for diagnosis; deployed browser, HTTP and handler timing still require production proof. Attachment environment names and case definitions, copy target identities and decoded source bindings are reused only within the current overview evaluation. Source presentation omits driver preparation receipts in both card and QA fact reads; canonical detail and recovery retain the full stored receipt. Query plans alone exclude transport, decoding and Python work; actual execution counts and deployed timing remain required.
